job.title: Software Engineer II
job.pay_full: $92,000 – $147,000 a year (O'Fallon, Missouri); may be eligible for an annual bonus or commissions depending on the role

details.about: Mastercard's Operational Intelligence Program builds business analytics and reporting products for its customers. This Software Engineer II joins the Operational Reports NexGen team, working on enterprise applications built on Java with Angular or React front ends, from design and testing to deployment and support.
duties: Turn business requirements into scalable, secure, maintainable software
Contribute to design and architecture discussions with guidance from senior engineers
Write unit, functional, integration and automated tests and support continuous integration
Take part in code reviews and apply secure coding practices
Build, deploy and support cloud applications on AWS with observability and monitoring
Troubleshoot production issues with root cause analysis and tune performance
needs: Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms and object-oriented design
Proficiency with J2EE, Java 8 or higher, JSP, Servlets, Spring 5 and Hibernate
Relational and non-relational databases such as Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL or MongoDB
Experience with unit, integration and automated testing, code reviews and OWASP-based secure coding
Experience with cloud-native applications on AWS and tools like Maven, Gradle, Jenkins and SonarQube
Strong troubleshooting, communication and collaboration skills
nice: Web services (SOAP, REST), WebSphere, JBoss or Tomcat, HTML, JavaScript, React or Angular, C#, UNIX scripting, XML/XSLT
Data engineering with Databricks, AWS or enterprise data platforms
Bachelor's in Information Systems, IT, Computer Science, Engineering or equivalent experience (preferred)
details.benefits: Pay range $92,000 – $147,000 a year in O'Fallon, Missouri; may be eligible for an annual bonus or commissions. Benefits generally include medical, prescription, dental, vision, disability and life insurance; FSA and HSA; 16 weeks of new parent leave; 25 days of vacation, 5 personal days and 80 hours of paid sick and safe time (pro-rated); 10 paid US holidays; 401(k) with company match; fitness reimbursement or on-site fitness; tuition reimbursement eligibility.
notes: Mastercard intends to fill this position by 01/10/2027
